scope: E3/E4/E5 component cohort, seed0, audited formal ledger only
metric_definition: Per fold: sum TP/union for each concept, then macro mean across concepts. Dataset fold-mIoU is the arithmetic mean of those fold metrics. Mean episode and equal-query-target IoU remain separately named.
uncertainty: Average references within query image+mask+concept first, then bootstrap whole image clusters, retaining all concepts from an image; 2000 repetitions with deterministic contrast-specific SHA seed. Exploratory intervals are unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

limitations: Simple similarity retains feature debias. INSID3 no_aggregation means seed-only after clustering, not a raw-feature similarity baseline.

CG single-to-candidates changes candidate count and score-based selection jointly; candidates-to-search enables search loops and restarts jointly. These do not isolate score formula or restart contribution.
CG concat is the query-side instance-union output of the project concatenation route; the frozen adapter explicitly does not claim exact reproduction of INSID3 Table9 mask-prompt details.
Full methods on standard/reference cohorts are separate E1/E2 data; component results are not substituted for full-set scores.
Matrix common input size is1008, but feature-grid geometry/pretraining differ; SAM3 trunk+INSID3 is an adaptation, not the full SAM3 decoder system.
Same-GPU matched timing subsets are reported separately; H200/L40S cross-device rows do not produce speed ratios. Timings exclude setup, queue wait and full server cost.
No mask pixels or external manifests were re-read. IoU/counts and recorded identity are checked from exported JSON.

Metadata export omitted some output run.json files; ledger binding_evidence distinguishes own binding, shared-manifest ID order, and count-only expected coverage. Paired observed episode identity is checked here, but this is not a claim of direct own-run binding evidence for every output.
The existing query/reference sampling and fixed thresholds do not establish tuned best-per-backbone or complete author-protocol reproduction.
